notes.title: Garage Version 1.1.261
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem where the number of frogs captured in different types of bottle trap's ground bait was incorrect.
- Fixed some typo for Chinese languages.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.1.259
notes.content: - Fixed a problem that caused the game to freeze when a confirmation dialog kept appearing while moving through scenes.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.1.256
notes.content:
- Full controller support. The operation manual available in the game option.
- Changed the cursor to be more visible.
- Fixed and improved a lot of minor issues.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.0.251
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem that cannot open the Tool or vendor menu on the non English Windows.
- Added two additional locations for secret stamps.
- Achievement: Reduced the number of refueling from female machines.
- Improved the flow for some dialogues.
- Fixed a problem that your location on the map is wrong when you move to follow Gimnon.
- Balanced a little for fishing.
- Fixed some typos.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.0.245
notes.content:
- Fixed some word and dialogue.
- Fixed and improved some tap area.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.0.243
notes.content:
- Added and improved some dialogue in the later chapter.
- Balanced a little for the fishing.
- Fixed typos and omissions.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.0.242
notes.content:
- Improved a part of navigation, etc.
- Fixed some dialogues and texts.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.0.241
notes.content:
- Fixed some pictures a little.
- No longer possible to enter the Juice's room after she's gone.
- Fixed some dialogues and texts.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.0.240
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that cannot take off the posters at Sewage Canal.
- Added some important dialogues to the Dialogue Log.
- Fixed some texts and minor issues, etc.

notes.title: Garage Version 1.0.239
notes.content:
- Added a new letter to the Lighthouse 1F.
- Added new dialogues for Ah-san, Moriwaki, Lao, and Guattari. These are all supplementary lines to learn more about this world.
- Tweaked the player character animations a little.
- Fixed and tweaked the tap area, texts, etc.
